decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is central to the firm's trusted second-channel and binding mobile communication strategy, so it is likely still part of the core platform.
Mobile PDF signing fits the firm's move toward online contract signing and is cheap to maintain, though it may be folded into a broader signing offer.
The multi-layer end-to-end architecture frames the whole integrated security offer and underpins the other products.
The email-to-app delivery robot is a niche feature at risk of being merged or rebranded, but it still supports the secure communication direction.
The QR hardware token serves banking customers who need PSD2 transaction authorization, although app-based methods are increasingly replacing hardware tokens.
Payment network security compliance stays relevant for regulated customers, though as a compliance suite it is somewhat peripheral to the identity focus.
